text:
harper.docs: opened PR #1102 to fix a couple of lingering issues in the rate-limits + usage analytics pages: broken dashboard links, outdated SDK headers, and an unclear pricing worked example. Preview: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1102

randy: thanks. TL;DR what changed?

harper.docs: summary: (1) update all SDK snippets to use Authorization: Bearer, (2) replace 'requests' examples with tokens/1k-token unit math, (3) add redirect rules for two old anchors and the billing FAQ link, (4) clarify "effective unit cost" paragraph with a worked example.

izzy: can you paste the redirect rules you added? want to sanity-check before merge.

harper.docs: pasted them in _redirects:```
#/legacy/pricing#tiers  /docs/quota#quota-tiers  301
#/billing/faq#rate-limits  /docs/rate-limits#faq  301
```

mina: SDK snippet note: Node example still shows X-Api-Key in the curl example. I'll paste a small replacement.

mina:```
# curl example (use Bearer token)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"status"}'
```

izzy: good. Also, update the example code that converts tokens->cost. People got confused because the dashboard "effective unit cost" is per 1k tokens, not per token. Maybe add a one-line callout.

harper.docs: added this note under the worked example: "Note: effective unit cost column shows price per 1,000 tokens. To estimate spend: tokens_used / 1000 * unit_cost."

support-bot: QA report: found docs link from customer email referencing /dashboards/usage?panelId=77 — the panel was reassigned and now panelId=189. Recommend adding an explicit redirect for that panel link as well.

harper.docs: added redirect rule: "#/dashboards/usage?panelId=77  /dashboards/usage?panelId=189  301"

randy: i18n catch: french translation of the pricing table wraps oddly. we should prefer stacked rows on small screens. could you add a responsive class?

harper.docs: added a small CSS tweak to make the table stack at <480px and filed #128 for the localization team to shorten fr keys.

mina: CI preview look good on desktop. I spot-checked mobile and anchors resolve. Snippets render correctly.

deploybot: site deploy queued for branch docs/ratequota-fixes. build started at 2026-03-25T08:45:10Z.

deploybot: preview build succeeded 1: https://deploy-preview-1102--docs.redwood.ai

harper.docs: merging in 5m. I'll send a short note to support & accounts with the redirect mappings so they can update saved links. If any follow-ups pop up (fr overflow or additional old panels), I'll open a follow-up patch. Thanks!
